rubrics.title: Lab 12 — Gun Violence Dashboards in Tableau Public and Gemini Canvas

criteria.description: New free personal Tableau Public account and Profile URL; separately published, correctly named six-field GVA source with validated types/IDs/dates. Check Create Data Source permission before starting.

Required named Workbook: four charts, shared Choose Measure/CASE, dynamic titles, correct counts, State filters, locality inspection, highlighter, source-title hyperlink, cumulative waterfall and reset.

Required public Gemini Canvas app: same CSV and four views, three measures, state selection/filter and Reset, one verified Select & ask improvement, read-only default data usable by a separate Google account.

Exactly two URLs: own Tableau Public Profile and public Gemini Canvas app; 4–6 sentences with two CSV-checked numbers, interaction/clarity comparison, one verified AI improvement, and incident-date range.
